release_gate.limitations: Small authored and synthetic evaluations, not production accuracy or a competitor benchmark. Neural predictions never authorize actions. Sales remains experimental. No customer queries or uploads are imported automatically.

limitations: 600 curated requests across existing intent families, not 600 distinct executable tools or a measured frequency ranking. Payroll, attendance and manager leave decisions remain native module handoffs. Wording probes were not fitted; parser fixes were informed by inspected development results.
